moglie.aspetto: an uncanny woman in her sixties who looks healthy but wrong, like a familiar face that is different from how you remember it: a stocky, healthy body; smooth, waxy, too-even skin with only a few fine lines; a neat helmet of grey hair that looks like a wig; eyes far too big and round, set a little too far apart, always wide open and staring, the white showing all around the dark irises; a small, still mouth; in a shapeless beige knitted cardigan over a dark floral housedress

parti.occhi: Her too-big, round eyes are wide open and staring, the white showing all around the dark irises; the whites are clear and healthy, only the rims a little red, as after a sleepless night shift: no fever, no sweat.
parti.bocca: Small, smooth lips parted just enough to show perfectly even white teeth, all of the same size, like dentures; healthy, nothing unusual.

collo.inquadratura: the side of her neck and the skin behind her ear, her wig-like grey hair pulled back
collo.segni: Smooth, waxy skin; two thin red lines pressed into it behind the ear and across the cheek, like the marks left by the elastic straps of a protective face mask worn for many hours; no swelling, no lumps.

mani.inquadratura: both hands held out in front, backs up, from the wrists to the fingertips
mani.segni: Rough, chapped, reddened hands with cracked knuckles, as from strong disinfectant; on the back of the right hand a faded blue ink stamp: a small triangle with a number inside, like an entry stamp.

marito.aspetto: an uncanny old man in his seventies who looks healthy but wrong, like a familiar face that is different from how you remember it: a slim body; an oversized, perfectly round, smooth pink bald head; pale grey-blue eyes, wide open, that never blink; big ears set too low; a long nose and a very long upper lip; a wide fixed grin with far too many small, even teeth; a long thin neck; big hands with long fingers, broad flat fingertips and faintly bluish nails; in an old white vest, wrapped in an olive-green blanket and a brown patterned blanket, the plastic tube of a nebulizer on his chest

parti.occhi: Pale grey-blue eyes, wide open and unblinking, staring straight ahead; the whites are clear and healthy: no fever, no sweat.

occhi_febbre.inquadratura: the eyes and the bridge of the nose, from the eyebrows to the cheekbones
occhi_febbre.segni: His pale, unblinking eyes are glassy and bloodshot with high fever, the rims red, beads of sweat on his smooth pink forehead and temples.

parti.bocca: A wide, fixed grin with far too many small, even white teeth in two neat rows; the lips are faintly purplish, and on the lower lip a little thick grey phlegm, no blood.
parti.collo: A long, thin, smooth neck, the tendons standing out with each breath; no swelling, no lumps.

collo_febbre.inquadratura: the side of the neck, from under the jaw to the collarbone
collo_febbre.segni: A long, thin, smooth neck; under the jaw a hard, swollen lump the size of a walnut, red and shiny: a plague bubo just beginning.

mani.inquadratura: both hands resting on his knees, from the wrists to the fingertips
mani.segni: Big hands with long fingers; the fingertips are swollen, broad and rounded like spatulas, the nails curved over them, and the nail beds are clearly bluish-purple, as from years of too little air; old white scars from quarry work; otherwise healthy skin.
